# Videorc

Videorc is an open-source, AI-native desktop studio for creators: record your screen and camera, stream to multiple platforms at once, and bring Orcle, an AI producer that keeps up with your chat while you're live. All from one window.

Current release tracks

 macOS Beta → — macOS 13+, Apple Silicon. Signed and notarized beta builds are the current public desktop release.
 Windows Alpha guide → — Windows 11 x64 only. A Windows installer is published only after the signed candidate, clean-machine, malware-scan, update, uninstall, and real-device acceptance gates pass. A CI artifact or unsigned local package is not a public alpha. [...] Videorc's macOS track is in Beta and its gated Windows track is in Alpha. Bug reports with reproduction steps are very welcome; Windows testers should use the privacy-safe Windows Alpha issue form and never attach credentials, recordings, or an unverified support bundle to a public issue. For larger changes, please open an issue first so we can agree on the shape before you invest in a PR. Read AGENTS.md before touching recording or native-preview code — those areas have non-negotiable verification gates.
